analysis:
CHANGELOG.md-only change (head lines 11-400 replace the v0.10.8 header with a v0.10.9 candidate section); no executable code, configuration or workflow files are in the supplied evidence. I read head lines 1-368 of the changelog. The changelog describes behavior of other files that were not supplied, so those claims are unverified here.

Security-relevant claims noted for later passes:
- CI: the Darkbloom watchdog workflow cancels and re-runs stranded runs, and the changelog says its token is limited to cancelling and re-running this repo's runs plus writing a check run (lines 59, 63). The new ci-dev/ci-master split (lines 65-70) drops Release Integrity, Docs Lint, Commit Signatures and Docs Impact for PRs into dev, while PRs into master keep them (line 68). This reduces the checks on dev, and the real gating depends on the workflow files and the rulesets, which were not supplied.
- CI test reuse (line 83) binds a record to tree, base and head commits. Its soundness cannot be verified from this file.
- The loose build-cache restore tiers (line 87) are restricted to non-master workflows. master restores only entries of its exact recipe, which is consistent with limiting cache-poisoning exposure.
- Release builds accept only Xcode 27.2, and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py refuses binaries that import the Date >=/<= weak symbols (lines 93-98). This matches the header note about A-018 availability.
- Cluster pairing: the changelog documents a block on single-Mac serving, automatic stepping aside, and version-skew handling (lines 17-27, 233-238). It also documents a known limitation that the DevNet app can read and affect production pair state (line 51). These are the pair-related claims to check against the cluster and coordinator code in other batches.
- The gpu-limit root action (TB-014, T-062) is described as confirm-then-administrator-prompt only, never automatic, and uninstall does not undo it (line 35). That is consistent with the threat model, but the code was not examined.

No new threat-model invalidation can be established from documentation alone. needs_deeper_review is false for this file.
